titulo: Wiping her feet before the clean house
caption:
Wiping her feet before the clean house

It rained all week. She wiped her feet on the mat until it was brown and then walked into the clean house.

Thirty seconds on the mat saves the host a mop, and nobody has to say anything.

For whoever wipes their feet at a friend's door before walking in.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with an open door on the right glowing warm yellow and a tan mat on the floor in front of it. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks onto the mat and shuffles back and forth, small dust puffs pop up from its feet and a brown patch spreads across the mat. Then its eyes turn happy and it walks into the open doorway with a pulse. The text stays: me wiping my feet at their door.
